channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington (heraldnet.com)

item.title: Editorial cartoons for Monday, March 9
item.description: A sketchy look at the news of the day.

item.title: Letter: Pay no attention to scare tactics on voter ID
item.description: Regarding the recent editorial on voter I.D. legislation in Congress (“Oppose efforts to deny elgible voters their right,” The Herale, Feb. 24): The article is full of misconceptions and scare tactics.

item.title: Letter: Trump should enlist ICE in war with Iran
item.description: OK, our ‘Peace-king” has started a war with Iran. We will more than likely lose some our sons and daughters before it’s over with.

item.title: Letter: What does a sophomore know about issues?
item.description: Local high school students are protesting ICE agents on their behavoir. These students have yet to suggest a different method, to locate and control the law breakers that have entered our country without proper documentation.

item.title: Comment: Trump isn’t nation-building; he’s puppet-making
item.description: As in Venezuela, Trump seeks to depose leaders but keep regimes in place that will follow orders.

item.title: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III headed to Chiefs
item.description: Seahawks to lose star running back and safety Coby Bryant in free agency, sources say.

item.title: Everett transfer station closes for $2.25 million upgrade
item.description: The tipping floor, where 25-ton trucks dump waste daily, will be repaired with more durable material.

item.title: Lake Stevens museum construction is underway
item.description: The Lake Stevens Historical Society called for donations to help fund future exhibits.

item.title: Vote for The Herald’s Prep Athlete of the Week for March 1-7
item.description: The Athlete of the Week nominees for March 1-7. Voting closes at midnight Sunday. The winner will be announced with the next poll and in next Wednesday’s paper.

item.title: Snohomish County’s ultimate burger bragging rights
item.description: From classic cheeseburgers to stacked creations, these local spots earned the top votes.
